name: Prompt MCP Server
description: Prompt generation MCP server: generates the full LLM prompt including system prompt, thread context, and message compaction

config_schema.label: Complexity Max Chars
config_schema.description: Max character count for simple prompts (greetings, short commands): these get no plan

config_schema.label: Plan Max Tokens
config_schema.description: Maximum tokens for the planning LLM call

config_schema.label: Memory Max Chars
config_schema.description: Maximum characters for the memory section in the system prompt

config_schema.label: Tokenizer Encoding
config_schema.description: Tokenizer encoding for budget calculations (e.g. 'cl100k_base'). Empty or invalid = tokens ≈ chars/4 fallback

config_schema.label: Condense Keep Turns
config_schema.description: Number of most recent assistant turns to preserve when condensing

config_schema.label: Tool Excerpt Chars
config_schema.description: Maximum characters retained per older tool result during compaction

config_schema.label: Total Excerpt Cap
config_schema.description: Maximum total excerpt characters retained during compaction

config_schema.label: Read Excerpt Chars
config_schema.description: Maximum characters retained for older read-only results during compaction

config_schema.label: Compact Keep Recent
config_schema.description: Number of recent assistant tool-call turns preserved during compaction

config_schema.label: Compact Max Passes
config_schema.description: Maximum progressive compaction passes per invocation

config_schema.label: Compact Keep Step
config_schema.description: Amount to reduce preserved recent turns between compaction passes

config_schema.label: Max Summary Chars
config_schema.description: Hard cap (chars) on the frozen compaction summary block. Without it the block grows on every compaction (strict superset, never drained), so once preamble + block + tail exceed the hard token budget compaction fires on EVERY iteration and each firing grows the block further — an unbounded death spiral (observed: thread 1726, 162 compactions in 300 iterations, block 66K→357K chars). Oldest entries are pruned (newest kept) when the cap is exceeded; drained content remains recoverable from context-*.json dumps and auto-notes.md.

label: prompt
